titulo: Abortion clinic-style protest bans could reduce ‘distress and anxiety’ at synagogues and Jewish schools, Dreyfus says
cuerpo: Former attorney general details antisemitic abuse at royal commission, saying he was labelled a ‘genocidal Zionist’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The former attorney general Mark Dreyfus has called on governments to consider banning protests outside synagogues and Jewish schools, invoking a high court decision allowing restrictions outside abortion clinics. The federal Labor backbencher told the antisemitism royal commission the laws should be considered in light of a 2019 high court decision upholding safe access zone laws in Victoria and Tasmania, which prohibit protests within 150 metres of abortion clinics.
